title: Two-Factor Authentication
description: Manage TOTP authentication and backup codes configuration

enabled.label: Enable Two-Factor Authentication
enabled.desc: When enabled, users can enable two-factor authentication to enhance account security.

algorithm.label: TOTP Algorithm Type
algorithm.desc: Select the hash algorithm used to generate TOTP verification codes.

timeStep.label: TOTP Time Step
timeStep.desc: The valid time window length for verification codes.

codeLength.label: TOTP Code Length
codeLength.desc: The number of digits in generated verification codes.

timeWindowOffset.label: Time Window Offset
timeWindowOffset.desc: Allowed time window offset for handling clock drift.

issuer.label: Issuer Name
issuer.desc: The issuer name displayed in authenticator apps.

backupCodesCount.label: Backup Codes Count
backupCodesCount.desc: The number of backup codes users can generate.

warning.algorithmChange: Changing the algorithm type, code length, or time step will invalidate the authenticator for already-bound users, requiring them to re-bind. Notify all bound users before making changes.
